title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs - Endpoints: Declarative Agent Access
description: Enables programmatic access to first‑party and tenant‑defined declarative agents via the Work IQ endpoint, allowing applications to trigger specialized agents for domain‑specific tasks within broader workflows.
